comparison.objective: Separate a glued phone display and open it on its cable side; candidate finishes installed thread inserts by breaking and collecting tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Suction lifting and adhesive cutting around an edge versus coaxial mandrel stabilization, hammering, and millimetre-scale loose-fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Adhesive fully freed, display safely supported, tools returned, and arms reset versus four physical fractures and complete containment without coil or shell damage.
comparison.reason: Both use two tools and damage avoidance, but their central mechanisms—progressive adhesive separation and impact notch fracture—are meaningfully different. No separate spec versions were provided.
